display.purpose: The character name on a character page. One per page.

headline.purpose: The page title. Exactly one h1 per page.

label.purpose: Controls and list meta. The most common size in a dense tool.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: A single hairline lift for small things that float one step off the page without claiming the overlay layer — toasts, the autocomplete dropdown, the reorder drag badge, and the selected chip inside the segmented control.

shadows.name: shadow-overlay
shadows.purpose: Modals and dialogs only. The one thing that says 'in front of the page'.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve. No bounce or elastic anywhere.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Colour and border state changes on controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid shape allowed on a screen. At most one per page.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:6px; font:500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.13,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.13,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.13,1); } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--accent,#0b7285); border-color:var(--accent,#0b7285); color:#fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover,#095c6b); border-color:var(--accent-hover,#095c6b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0b7285); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The workhorse: a hairline outline, not a filled shape. Most buttons are this.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#c8cdd7); border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#1c2029); font:500 0.875rem/1 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.13,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-hover,#f1f3f6); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0b7285); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Hairline separation, never a shadow. The page-level container.
components.html:
Most popular series

441 series in the library.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--surface,#fff); border:1px solid var(--border,#e2e6ec); border-radius:10px; padding:24px; font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.015em; color:var(--text,#1c2029); } .ds-card-meta { margin:0; font-size:0.875rem; color:var(--text-muted,#5c6575); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Hairline stroke; the border shifts to the accent on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong,#c8cdd7); border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#1c2029); font:400 0.875rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0.13,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-subtle,#7c8595); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0b7285); outline-offset:2px; border-color:var(--accent,#0b7285); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A pill well with a raised chip inside. A real radiogroup, not two buttons that look like one.
components.html: NameSeries
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; padding:2px; border:1px solid var(--border,#e2e6ec); border-radius:999px; background:var(--surface-sunken,#f1f3f6); font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-seg-opt { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:26px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:999px; font-size:0.8125rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-muted,#5c6575); cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg-opt.is-on { background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--text,#1c2029); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 20 28 / 0.06); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small inline count. Tabular figures so it does not reflow as it changes.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface-sunken,#f1f3f6); color:var(--text-muted,#5c6575); font:500 0.8125rem/1.4 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Contact Strip
components.description: The ranked lists on the landing page — frames butted into one hairline-divided band. A proof sheet of the week.
components.html:
1. 1Kamisato AyakaGenshin Impact
  2. 2RemRe:Zero
components.css: .ds-strip { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr)); border:1px solid var(--border,#e2e6ec); border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-strip-item + .ds-strip-item .ds-strip-link { border-left:1px solid var(--border,#e2e6ec); } .ds-strip-link { display:block; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; } .ds-strip-shot { display:block; width:100%; aspect-ratio:9/14; background:var(--surface-sunken,#f1f3f6); object-fit:cover; } .ds-strip-caption { display:grid; gap:1px; padding:8px; background:var(--surface,#fff); } .ds-strip-rank { font:600 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--text-subtle,#7c8595); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-strip-name { font:500 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-strip-series { font:400 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--text-muted,#5c6575); overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Series Bar
components.description: One row per series with a hairline bar measuring its share of the largest character count.
components.html:
• Genshin Impact808 · 31
  • Fate210 · 9
components.css: .ds-series { display:grid; gap:8px; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-series-item { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:baseline; gap:4px 12px; padding:4px 0; text-decoration:none; color:var(--text,#1c2029); } .ds-series-name { font-weight:500; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-series-meta { font:400 0.8125rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--text-muted,#5c6575); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-series-track { grid-column:1/-1; height:2px; background:var(--surface-sunken,#f1f3f6); } .ds-series-fill { display:block; height:100%; background:var(--border-strong,#c8cdd7); } .ds-series-item:hover .ds-series-fill { background:var(--accent,#0b7285); } .ds-series-item:hover .ds-series-name { color:var(--accent,#0b7285); }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Says what is absent and how it would get here. Deliberately distinct from a search that matched nothing.
components.html:
Nothing hidden

Images you hide from a character page will collect here.
components.css: .ds-empty { padding:40px 24px; text-align:center; font-family:var(--font-sans, Geist, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-empty-title { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--text,#1c2029); } .ds-empty-desc { margin:0; font-size:0.875rem; color:var(--text-muted,#5c6575); }

narrative.overview:
A photographer's contact sheet is a dense, ordered grid of real images with almost no chrome around it, made for someone doing a job rather than someone browsing. That is what this interface is. The character artwork is the content, the content is photographic, and every decision about the frame exists to keep the frame out of the way.

The register is a dense, restrained tool — Linear and Vercel rather than a consumer product. Surfaces are white or near-black, separated by hairlines rather than shadows. Neutrals are tinted toward blue (hue ~222) and never pure grey, because untinted grey is the most reliable signal that no palette was chosen at all. Type is Geist, self-hosted, with negative tracking on anything large. Light and dark are equally first-class, derived from one token set.

The one thing this system refuses to do is compete with the pictures. Chrome is grey; artwork is not.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline separation; shadows only for things that genuinely float
One accent, used only to mark state
Images at their true aspect ratio, in justified rows
Equal-weight light and dark, following the system by default

rules.name: The Art Carries the Colour Rule
rules.body: The accent marks state and nothing else: focus, selection, the active tab, at most one solid button per screen. No coloured headers, no gradient surfaces, no tinted cards. The character artwork is the only saturated thing on screen.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure grey anywhere. Every neutral carries the ~222 hue cast. A #888 in a diff is a bug.

rules.name: The Subtle-Tint Pairing Rule
rules.body: --accent-subtle takes --accent as its foreground; --accent-fg belongs only on solid --accent. A test enforces this, because the failure mode is invisible text rather than a crash.

rules.name: The Negative Tracking Rule
rules.body: Anything at title size or larger gets negative letter spacing. Default tracking on large type is the clearest tell of an unconsidered heading.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number that updates in place carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Numbers that reflow as they change read as broken.

rules.name: The Four Breakpoints Rule
rules.body: 480, 768, 960, 1200. A fifth value in a media query is a bug, not a refinement.

rules.name: The Line Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: The default separator is a 1px border. Reach for a shadow only when the element genuinely floats, and then use one of the two that exist.

dos: Do put every colour in tokens.css. A hex literal anywhere else is a bug — the system was built by removing 387 of them.
Do use the four radii (4/6/10/999) and the 4px spacing scale. A value outside the scale means the scale is wrong; fix the scale.
Do pair a -subtle tint with its own base colour as foreground, never with -fg.
Do give large type negative tracking (−0.015em at title, −0.022em at display).
Do use tabular-nums on any figure that updates in place.
Do let images keep their real aspect ratio in galleries, and crop only character portraits, which have one canonical shape.
Do define every colour in the base :root block. A token whose only definition lives in a media query renders as nothing in a browser that never matches it.
Do reach for Button, Card, Input, Field, Modal, Badge, EmptyState before writing a new control.

Do give every dialog a visible close button beside its title. Backdrop dismissal and Escape are conveniences layered on top of real controls — on a phone the backdrop is a thin band nobody can reliably hit and Escape needs a keyboard, so a dialog with no visible button has no way out of it. The rule was written before the button existed; a test now enforces it.
donts: Don't saturate the chrome. No coloured headers, gradient surfaces or tinted cards — the artwork is the only saturated thing on screen.
Don't use pure grey. Every neutral carries the ~222 hue cast.
Don't use Bootstrap's palette, or a purple-to-violet gradient. Both were removed deliberately.
Don't add a third shadow. Two exist; a new one means the depth vocabulary is being reinvented.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. One curve (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0.13, 1)) and two durations (120ms, 180ms).
Don't put more than one solid accent button on a screen.

Don't show a control that cannot act. A verb belongs on screen when the selection contains something for it to act on, and absent otherwise — a disabled button with a count of zero is a dead end wearing the clothes of an action.
Don't write an inline style to resize a control. That is what the size variants are for, and the inline override is the exact thing the primitives replaced.
Don't remove focus outlines. One ring, on :focus-visible, everywhere.

Don't write a page's responsive rules in a different file from its base rules. A media query adds no specificity, so a later rule of equal specificity wins at every width. Nine declarations for the character page lived in components.css, were beaten by pages.css, and had never once applied — the header was written to stack on a phone and never did. Keep both halves of a rule in one file, and let the import order in index.css mean what it says.
